name: Canvas
instructions: A shared drawing page. Diagrams live in this plugin's local database. Agents use canvas_read / canvas_edit or kg canvas show. Copy note puts a short pointer on the clipboard for the person to paste into a thread — it does not post to the thread. Clipboard read is for paste of copied shapes.

tools.name: canvas_read
tools.description: Read a shared drawing canvas as one line per element. Without a name, lists the canvases.

tools.name: canvas_edit
tools.description: Draw on a shared canvas by applying a list of ops. Returns new ids and the lines that changed. The canvas must already exist.
